system.description:
Requirements: Training (2) or Expertise (2) in Arcana

You recapture the energy of spells you have attuned to, allowing you to more easily cast spells of that type.

While affected by an Attunement spell, if you successfully cast a spell with the trait you have attuned to, you gain 1 Echo Charge, to a maximum of 3 Charges. Alternatively, you may use an Action to build a Charge, These Charges last until the Attunement spell expires.

You may expend any number of Charges when you cast a spell with the attuned trait to reduce the Complexity of the spell by -1 to a minimum of 1,

Alternativity, you may reduce the Difficulty of the spell by -1 to a minimum of 4.

You must make this choice before you roll the casting check.

If you have multiple Attunement spells active, you must track the charges separately.
